output.summary: Mostly large deciduous trees native across most of the temperate Northern Hemisphere. They have heart-shaped, usually asymmetrical toothed leaves and strongly scented yellow-green flowers. Flowers are brewed as tea in several regions, while leaf buds and young leaves are edible raw.
output.edibilityNote: Flowers are brewed as herbal tea in Europe, the Balkans and China; leaf buds and young leaves are eaten raw.
